title: Warm German Schnitzel Gratin
description: A rich, gooey solo dinner German dish featuring Dijon mustard, blanch-season, and Ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Dust the veal cutlets with flour on both sides.
In a shallow dish, mix together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
In another shallow dish, mix together the panko breadcrumbs and a pinch of salt.
Dip each veal cutlet in the egg mixture, coating completely, then coat in breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 2 veal cutlets to the skillet and cook until golden brown on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the cooked veal cutlets to a baking dish.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the skillet.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Sprinkle the grated gruyère cheese over the cooked veal cutlets.
Top with the cooked onion and garlic mixture.
Sprinkle the nutritional yeast over the top.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 12-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
